head: codex/5865-maintained-quic-tls-adapter
title: [v0.92][WP-04.03] Maintained QUIC/TLS transport adapter
body:
Closes danielbaustin/agent-design-language#5865

## Summary

- add maintained TLS 1.3 mutual-authentication transport with exact certificate and logical peer binding
- use AWS-LC as the single Rustls cryptographic provider across Quinn and the existing Tokio/Axum TLS stack
- bind every session to WP-04.02 Transport-purpose authority with revocation and expiry revalidation
- reject duplicate and stale sequence replay through a bounded receive window
- enforce bounded streams, waits, canonical prost framing, cancellation, and exact frame ceilings
- pin the reviewed quinn 0.11.11, rustls 0.23.42, prost 0.13.5, and openraft 0.9.21 set

## Validation

- focused transport target — 10 passed
- full adl-runtime parity — 244 passed
- the two prior TLS-provider failures — passed
- the two CI authorization-boundary failures — 20 consecutive repetitions passed
- strict focused Clippy — passed
- exact v3 proof receipt — passed
- independent exact-head review — passed with no findings

## Boundary

This child owns only the transport adapter, its focused tests, and the serialized runtime manifest/lock update. OpenRaft authority-ledger implementation remains with WP-04.07. WP-04.16 must wire generation-update events to the adapter cancellation token and prove immediate closure of already-blocked old-generation sessions.
